_comment: For a local VibeVoice server (vibevoice-fastapi), which is already OpenAI-compatible — set the TTS Server URL to its host:port. Streaming PCM keeps time-to-first-audio low. NOTE: on modest GPUs this backend generates near or below 1x realtime and can starve a live call; use the Test voice button to check the realtime factor, and prefer cloud for the live leg if it warns.
